info.title: PinePods API
info.description: HTTP API for the PinePods podcast server. Most endpoints require an `Api-Key` header tied to a user account; admin-only endpoints additionally require an admin (or web) key. This reference is generated directly from the backend source, so it stays in sync with the running code.

AiSettingsUpdate.description:
Update payload from the settings page. `llm_api_key` is only written when `Some(non-empty)`,
so leaving the field blank preserves the stored key; `clear_api_key` removes it.

last_used_at.description: Unix seconds; null if never used.

ClientStatus.description: What this server's Podping client has done, for the admin settings.

pings_seen.description: Announcements seen since this server started.

auto_add_categories.description: Podcast categories whose episodes are auto-added to this collection (None = disabled).

person_id.description: A person PinePods already knows (from a credit or search result).

role.description: Defaults to "host" on a podcast and "guest" on an episode.

episode_id.description: Credit these people on one episode instead of the whole show.

label.description: What it's for, e.g. "AntennaPod on my phone".

auto_add_categories.description: Podcast categories to auto-add episodes from (None/empty = disabled).

backfill.description: When true, immediately backfill existing matching episodes after saving.

min_duration.description: Minimum episode length in **minutes** (stored, and returned by get_playlists, in seconds).

max_duration.description: Maximum episode length in **minutes** (stored, and returned by get_playlists, in seconds).

sort_order.description: One of date_asc, date_desc, duration_asc, duration_desc, listen_progress, completion.

password.description: Shown this once; only a hash is stored.

CreditedPerson.description: A person as shown on a podcast or episode page.

id.description: PinePods person id (`Persons.PersonID`); use it for the person page and follows.

roles.description: Every role this person has here, most significant first.

scope.description:
"podcast": credited on the show itself or a regular across its episodes.
"episodes": credited only on some episodes. "episode": credited on this episode.

episode_count.description: Episodes of this podcast the person is credited on.

verified.description: False when every credit is an unreviewed community submission.

ExternalEpisode.description: An episode from a show outside the user's library.

FailingFeed.description: One of the user's podcasts that's failing right now.

error.description: The last error, as the host or the parser reported it.

reported.description: Over the reporting threshold (and so reported).

feeds.description: Podcasts whose last refresh failed, longest-failing first.

imports.description: Feeds from sync apps that couldn't be added, oldest first.

source.description:
Where the subscription came from: `client` (an app on the PinePods gpodder server) or
`target` (the external sync server).

InAppNotification.description:
A durable, no-progress notification ("message"/"alert") shown in the Activity
center's Messages / "Needs attention" sections. Distinct from a `TaskInfo`
(which has progress and a lifecycle). Persisted per-user in Redis and streamed
over the same task WebSocket. See the notification redesign plan.

link.description: Optional in-app link the message can deep-link to.

expires_at.description: Server-authoritative expiry. List reads drop anything past this instant.

MsgSeverity.description:
Durable in-app notification severity. Mirrored on the frontend
(`web/src/components/context.rs`). `warning`/`error` count toward the bell
badge; `info`/`success` do not.

NowPlayingSnapshot.description:
An ephemeral snapshot of what one device is playing, mirrored into Valkey with
a TTL so other devices can see it and send remote-control commands. This is a
best-effort mirror, never the source of truth for playback (see the
"aware, not owns" principle) — the device's local player stays authoritative.

updated_at.description: Unix seconds when this snapshot was last updated (server-stamped on write).

capabilities.description:
Actions the device says it applies (from its `capabilities` connect
parameter). Empty means it didn't say: assume the original action set.

person_id.description: PinePods person id, when this server already knows them.

known_for.description: A few podcasts they're known for, to tell namesakes apart.

PersonPodcast.description: A podcast a person is credited on.

podcastid.description: The user's podcast id, or None for a show outside their library.

episodes.description: Library episodes the person is credited on (directly, or as a podcast's host), newest first.

external_episodes.description: Recent episodes from shows outside the library.

refreshing.description: True while the external episode list is being refreshed in the background.

people.description: Hosts, co-hosts and anyone else credited on the show or appearing as a regular.

guests.description: Guests and other episode-only credits, most frequent first.

relay_url.description: Where announcements are read from (`PINEPODS_PODPING_URL`, else the search service).

relay.description: The relay's own status (`following`: it keeps up with Hive), when it answered.

relay_error.description: Why the relay's status couldn't be read (e.g. a search service without the relay).

playing_episode_id.description:
Optional hint: the episode currently playing on the caller's device, so the
server can insert the new episode directly *under* it ("play next"). When
absent the episode is inserted at the top of the queue. Ignored by
remove_queued_pod. The anchor may itself be a YouTube video, hence the
companion `playing_is_youtube` flag for an unambiguous lookup.

episode_duration.description:
The player's duration for the episode in seconds, if it knows it. Stored when the feed
gave none (new episodes beyond the newest few are inserted with duration 0).

ReorderQueueItem.description:
A single queue entry in a reorder request. Carries `is_youtube` so the server
can disambiguate a podcast `EpisodeID` from a YouTube `VideoID` that happen to
share the same integer (they come from independent autoincrement sequences).

episodes.description: Preferred, type-aware ordering. Element 0 becomes queue position 1 (top).

episode_ids.description:
Legacy id-only ordering, kept for backward compatibility with older clients.
Used only when `episodes` is absent.

message.description: The error, when the run failed (also stored on the target).

task_id.description: The background task running the first (full) sync.

url.description: The search service's address (`SEARCH_API_URL` without its path).

origin.description: `pinepods`, `client` (an app on the PinePods server) or `target` (the external server).

name.description: The id the app registered (what it addresses the device by).

protected.description: Pinepods' own device: can't be renamed or removed.

username.description: The username to enter in apps.

server_url.description: The server URL to enter in apps.

server_url_configured.description:
`server_url` comes from `PINEPODS_PUBLIC_URL`; otherwise it was guessed from the request
and a client may prefer the URL it reached Pinepods at.

notice.description:
A notice for the settings page, e.g. `reenter_external`: the external sync server has to
be entered again.

subscriptions.description: Podcasts shared with apps and the external server.

devices.description: Apps on the PinePods server (not counting Pinepods itself).

last_change.description: Unix seconds: when the newest episode action was received.

device_name.description: Pinepods' device on a gpodder server.

needs_full_sync.description: The next run is a full sync (new server, or a full sync that hasn't succeeded yet).

in_backoff.description: Automatic syncs are paused after failures until `retry_at`; "Sync now" still runs.

pending_subscriptions.description: Changes waiting to be sent; null until the first sync has succeeded.

oneOf.description: Null when no external sync server is set up.

password.description: Leave out to reuse the stored password of the same server and account.

device_name.description: gpodder only: the device Pinepods syncs as. Left out: keep the current one, or pick one.

completed_at.description: When the task reached SUCCESS/FAILED — drives "Done" ordering + relative time.

art_url.description: Cover art for the card thumbnail.

detail.description: Sub-line detail (e.g. "72 of 128 feeds"; on failure, the reason).

group.description: Shared key folding sibling tasks into one collapsible group.

total.description: Total item count a grouped run is working through (for "x of N").

device_name.description: gpodder only: the device Pinepods would sync as.

auto_add_categories.description: Podcast categories to auto-add episodes from (empty vec clears the rule).

backfill.description: When true, immediately backfill existing matching episodes after saving.

min_duration.description: Minimum episode length in **minutes** (stored, and returned by get_playlists, in seconds).

max_duration.description: Maximum episode length in **minutes** (stored, and returned by get_playlists, in seconds).

sort_order.description: One of date_asc, date_desc, duration_asc, duration_desc, listen_progress, completion.

Hashed_PW.description: Always null: the password hash is never sent to clients. Kept for response compatibility.

Salt.description: Always null; kept for response compatibility.

YtDlpSettingsUpdate.description: Update payload from the settings page (only the two user-editable fields).
